notes: Wild-type MG1655 only; the axis is aeration (aerobic vs microaerobic), which is an oxygen label, not a treatment, so treatment none and every sample is an untreated reference-genotype control (one per oxygen condition). Harvest density is given as OD460 0.5-0.6, not OD600, and no phase word, so growth_phase left out. Fermentor with sparging/stirring at 200 rpm -> batch_bioreactor. WT re-read: unmodified MG1655, so wild_type.
